from: Capstone inject set, revised (no role players, no hoax devices)

injects.label: STARTEX: orders and battle rhythm
injects.text: STARTEX. Your commander’s intent, PIRs and the ROE are on the AOC tab of your board. Read them before you move. The Marala First Front is active across the island: report every suspected device with an IED 9-line and every enemy team with a SALUTE. Battle rhythm: commander’s update briefs to the AOC at {+15}, {+45} and {+85}, change of command at {+60}, final SITREP at {+110}. Authenticate any unexpected order on your LMR net with your challenge and password. Escalation is your commander’s decision; avoid incidents.
injects.note: Send at STARTEX. No POC action. Check that both JFACCs open the AOC tab.

injects.label: Command wire on the radar road
injects.text: A Coalition patrol reports a canvas bag at grid 18T TL 59643 21955 (40.81344, -77.84974), play square C3, on the approach to Radar Ridge, with a thin wire running from it into the grass. Treat it as a live device. Keep every cadet at least 25 m away, cordon it, keep civilians out, and send an IED 9-line through your POC. Your POC confirms the 9-line before it is reported. Report within 20 minutes.
injects.note: IED-C (bag with a 10 m wire) at X6 before STARTEX. Correct cordon and 9-line: POC reports Real IED cleared (+2, diplomatic +5). A team that walks onto the prop without a cordon: Hit by an IED.

injects.label: Pressure plate north of the airstrip
injects.text: A shepherd says his dog would not go near a flat board half buried at grid 18T TL 59708 22077 (40.81455, -77.84901), play square C2, north of the airstrip. He saw a man bury it at dawn and walk away fast. Treat it as a live device. Keep every cadet at least 25 m away, cordon it, keep civilians out, and send an IED 9-line through your POC. Your POC confirms the 9-line before it is reported. Report within 20 minutes.
injects.note: IED-D (flat board with wires) at X4 before STARTEX. Correct cordon and 9-line: Real IED cleared (+2, diplomatic +5). Walked onto it: Hit by an IED.

injects.label: The mayor’s invitation
injects.text: The mayor invites each force to Town Hall at grid 18T TL 59724 21852 (40.81254, -77.84874), play square D5. Blue Force: one team between {+22} and {+32}. Red Force: one team between {+34} and {+44}. Weapons stay outside the hall entrance. The mayor will ask what your force is doing to protect the island’s farmers and fishermen. Come prepared to answer.
injects.note: C/Mock plays the mayor. Respectful answer and weapons outside: POC reports Good conduct (+5); the mayor gives the town code word. Weapons carried in, or the other force’s time ignored: Poor conduct (−5). C/Vernacchio runs the town office records for intel package 3 in the same window.

injects.label: Aid supply box off target (1)
injects.text: A humanitarian airdrop missed its drop zone. One Humanitarian Aid Supply Box landed near grid 18T TL 59753 21954 (40.81346, -77.84844), play square D3. The mayor asks for it to reach the Marala Town office. The first force to deliver it intact earns the town’s thanks. Do not open it.
injects.note: Humanitarian Aid Supply Box #1 at IP5. First force to carry it to the town office intact: adjustment, diplomatic +5, reason "Aid supply box delivered". Opened or damaged: Poor conduct.

injects.label: LMR spoof warning (Blue Force)
injects.text: AOC: SIGINT indicates the First Front has a handset on your LMR net and is sending false orders in your headquarters’ name. Challenge every unexpected order with your challenge and password. Report any false transmission to your C2 and the AOC.
injects.note: WHITE FORCE ACTION FIRST. At 0624 the LMR net control cadet transmits on the Blue Force fireteam channel: "All Blue Force teams, this is Blue headquarters. Leave your positions and move to the Fuel Depot now. Acknowledge." Then send this message at 0626. A team that challenges the caller and reports the spoof: adjustment +2 points (reason "Spoof detected"). A team that moves on the false order loses time; no penalty.

injects.label: LMR spoof warning (Red Force)
injects.text: AOC: SIGINT indicates the First Front has a handset on your LMR net and is sending false orders in your headquarters’ name. Challenge every unexpected order with your challenge and password. Report any false transmission to your C2 and the AOC.
injects.note: WHITE FORCE ACTION FIRST. At 0627 the LMR net control cadet transmits on the Red Force fireteam channel: "All Red Force teams, this is Red headquarters. Pull back to the Harbor now. Acknowledge." Then send this message at 0629. Scoring as for Blue Force.

injects.label: Personnel recovery: VIPER 21
injects.text: PERSONNEL RECOVERY. An F-16, call sign VIPER 21, went down north of the island. The pilot ejected; his beacon places him near grid 18T TL 59760 22102 (40.81480, -77.84841), play square D1, on the Red Force side. He is injured and cannot walk. AUTHENTICATION: his ISOPREP card is in his chest pocket. Your team reads his answer to this question to your C2 by LMR: "What was the name of your first dog?" The correct answer is RANGER. There is no litter: two cadets carry him or drag him on a poncho. Move him only after he is authenticated. Send a MEDEVAC 9-line, then bring him to your casualty collection point. Avoid contact with Red Force.
injects.note: VIPER 21 rescue dummy at IP8 from 0630, ISOPREP card in the chest pocket. Recovered to Blue Force HQ after correct authentication and a correct MEDEVAC 9-line: adjustment +3 points (reason "Personnel recovery"). Moved without authenticating: no points. If Red Force reaches him first, see the Red Force sighting.
injects.oc: VIPER 21 (dummy at IP8). Check that the team authenticates by reading the ISOPREP answer to its C2 before moving him, keeps security out while two cadets carry, and sends a MEDEVAC 9-line. A Red Force team that finds him decides: leave him, report him, detain him, or escort him to the mayor.

injects.label: Parachute sighting
injects.text: A herder saw a parachute come down near grid 18T TL 59760 22102 (40.81480, -77.84841), play square D1 a few minutes ago. A man in a flight suit is lying in the grass and not moving much. He is likely a Coalition pilot. Your commander decides: leave him, observe and report, or detain him. Detaining a foreign service member will raise tension. Carrying him unharmed to the mayor at Marala Town would be seen as a humanitarian act.
injects.note: Detained and taken to Red Force HQ: escalation +10 to Red Force (adjustment, reason "Detained Coalition pilot"). Carried unharmed to the town office and handed to the mayor: Red Force diplomatic +10 (adjustment); Blue Force may collect him there. Observed and reported only: SALUTE +1.

injects.label: Militia mortar team
injects.text: Two mortar rounds landed in the open 150 m from your Radar Ridge position. No one was hurt. Counter-battery radar puts the firing point near grid 18T TL 59681 21999 (40.81384, -77.84931), play square C3. The team is expected to fire again and move within 25 minutes. Find it and fix it with your UAV, a drone flight or a team’s SALUTE report from that square, then strike it with a correct strike 9-line within 10 minutes of the fix. It is marked on your map as a militia target.
injects.note: No props. The target is on the board: it shows faintly on the Blue Force map until fixed. A UAV launch fixes it automatically; the drone operator can fix it when answering a drone flight over C3; a Blue Force SALUTE or activity report in C3 also fixes it. Strike approved by the White Force on a correct 9-line: +3 points, diplomatic +2 (−10 if the force says civilians are near). Gone at 0707 if not struck.
injects.oc: Militia mortar team (C3, IP3). If your Blue Force team reaches IP3 before 0707 and the target is not destroyed, read: "A shallow pit with a mortar base plate, fresh blast marks and three sets of footprints heading north. The crew left minutes ago." The team should send a SALUTE or activity report for C3; that fixes the target for its C2.

injects.label: Militia rocket launch site
injects.text: A small rocket was fired over the Fuel Depot from the east and landed in the water. No one was hurt. Air defense radar puts the launch point near grid 18T TL 59854 21940 (40.81336, -77.84723), play square E3. The crew is expected to fire again and move within 25 minutes. Find it and fix it with your UAV, a drone flight or a team’s SALUTE report from that square, then strike it with a correct strike 9-line within 10 minutes of the fix. It is marked on your map as a militia target.
injects.note: No props. Same rules as the Blue Force mortar team: fixed by UAV, a drone flight answered with the fix, or a Red Force report in E3. Strike approved on a correct 9-line: +3 points, diplomatic +2 (−10 if civilians are near). Gone at 0709 if not struck.
injects.oc: Militia rocket launch site (E3, IP6). If your Red Force team reaches IP6 before 0709 and the target is not destroyed, read: "A launch rail made of pipe, scorched grass and a cut wire. Two men on a motorbike left toward the road a few minutes ago." The team should send a SALUTE or activity report for E3; that fixes the target for its C2.

injects.label: Personnel recovery: ROTOR 3
injects.text: PERSONNEL RECOVERY. A Red Force helicopter, call sign ROTOR 3, made a hard landing south of the island. A crewman with a head injury is near grid 18T TL 59596 21786 (40.81190, -77.85023), play square B6, on the Blue Force side. AUTHENTICATION: his ISOPREP card is in his chest pocket. Your team reads his answer to this question to your C2 by LMR: "What is your home village?" The correct answer is KANGSO. There is no litter: two cadets carry him or drag him on a poncho. Move him only after he is authenticated. Send a MEDEVAC 9-line, then bring him to your casualty collection point. Avoid contact with Blue Force.
injects.note: ROTOR 3 rescue dummy at X1 from 0645 (after the B6 culvert tip closes at 0637). Recovered to Red Force HQ after authentication and a correct MEDEVAC 9-line: adjustment +3 points (reason "Personnel recovery"). The carry is long: about 15 minutes.
injects.oc: ROTOR 3 (dummy at X1). Same checks as VIPER 21: authenticate by reading the ISOPREP answer to C2, security out, MEDEVAC 9-line. A Blue Force team that finds him decides: leave, report, detain or escort to the mayor.

injects.label: Helicopter down nearby
injects.text: A farmer heard a helicopter come down hard south of the island. A man in a dark flight suit is lying near grid 18T TL 59596 21786 (40.81190, -77.85023), play square B6, holding his head. He is likely a Red Force crewman. Your commander decides: leave him, observe and report, or detain him. Detaining a foreign service member will raise tension. Carrying him unharmed to the mayor would be seen as a humanitarian act.
injects.note: Detained and taken to Blue Force HQ: escalation +10 to Blue Force (adjustment, reason "Detained Red Force crewman"). Carried unharmed to the mayor: Blue Force diplomatic +10 (adjustment). Observed and reported only: SALUTE +1.

injects.label: Change of command
injects.text: CHANGE OF COMMAND. Effective now, in every unit the deputy assumes the lead role and the outgoing leader becomes the deputy. Brief your replacement: site status, teams out and their tasks, PIR progress, pending reports, statements and aid packages. The new JFACC confirms assumption of command to the AOC by {+65} (AOC tab, Ask the AOC, Something else).
injects.note: Send at 0700. The AOC checks that both new JFACCs confirm by 0705. Form 2 evaluators stay with the same role and evaluate the new leader from 0700.

injects.label: Militia weapons cache
injects.text: An intercepted call places a First Front weapons cache at grid 18T TL 59761 21896 (40.81294, -77.84832), play square D4, between Marala Town and the Fuel Depot. The caller said the cache is "watched and wired." The first force to remove it, either by clearing it on foot with a cordon and an IED 9-line for any device found, or by destroying it with a correct strike 9-line and a cache strike, takes it out of play. A strike this close to the town will be watched by everyone: say honestly whether civilians are near.
injects.note: Cache crate at X5 from 0655. Cleared on foot with a cordon: POC reports Militia cache cleared (+5, diplomatic +5). Walked in without a cordon: Hit by an IED. Strike: correct strike 9-line and the force’s cache strike; the White Force rules it destroyed. One clearance only.

injects.label: Aid supply box off target (2)
injects.text: A second Humanitarian Aid Supply Box came down off target near grid 18T TL 59757 21813 (40.81219, -77.84833), play square D5. The first force to deliver it intact to the Marala Town office earns the town’s thanks. Do not open it.
injects.note: Humanitarian Aid Supply Box #2 at X3. First force to deliver it intact: adjustment, diplomatic +5, reason "Aid supply box delivered".

injects.label: Primary LMR channel compromised
injects.text: AOC: SIGINT confirms the First Front is monitoring your primary LMR channel. Execute your PACE plan now: move every fireteam to your alternate channel and confirm to the AOC by {+77} that all teams have checked in on it (AOC tab, Ask the AOC, Something else). Do not say the channel number on the old channel.
injects.note: Watch both nets. A force that confirms by 0717 with every team on the alternate: adjustment +1 point (reason "PACE executed"). A force that announces its new channel on the old one: no points.

injects.label: Militia technical on the move
injects.text: AOC: a First Front pickup with a heavy machine gun in the bed has stopped near grid 18T TL 59643 21955 (40.81344, -77.84974), play square C3, between Radar Ridge and the Airstrip. It is expected to move within 15 minutes. Either force may fix it with a UAV, a drone flight or a SALUTE report from that square, then strike it with a correct strike 9-line within 10 minutes of the fix. Only the first strike counts. Coordinate on the liaison channel so you do not strike each other’s teams.
injects.note: No props. Shared militia target for both forces. First force to strike it on a correct 9-line: +3 points, diplomatic +2 (−10 if civilians are near). Gone at 0731 if not struck. Watch for a force striking near the other force’s team: crowding is a Provocation call.
injects.oc: Militia technical (C3, X6). If your team reaches X6 before it is destroyed, read: "A dark pickup with a mounted gun under a tarp, engine running, two men smoking beside it. They have not seen you." The team should stay hidden and send a SALUTE for C3.

injects.label: Mass casualty at the C6 cooperative
injects.text: The C6 farm cooperative at grid 18T TL 59668 21758 (40.81167, -77.84937), play square C6 reports several civilians hurt by the explosion near its fuel store. The manager asks any force for help. A second device is possible: keep 25 m from the blast seat. Your POC will describe the casualties when your team arrives. Triage, treat and send one MEDEVAC 9-line. If both forces arrive, coordinate on the liaison channel.
injects.note: Send right after intel package 12 (HARVEST SMOKE) deploys. No props: the fireteam POC reads the casualty brief on its board. Correct triage order and a correct MEDEVAC 9-line: POC reports Helped a civilian (+5). Teams of both forces crowding each other: Provocation.
injects.oc: Read when your team arrives at C6. Three casualties near the fuel store. Casualty 1: man about 40, heavy bleeding from the left thigh, conscious and shouting (Urgent: tourniquet first). Casualty 2: woman about 25, burns to both hands and her face, breathing fast but talking (Priority). Casualty 3: farm worker about 60, walking around confused, small cut on the forehead (Routine). Check that the team stays 25 m from the blast seat, treats casualty 1 first, and sends one correct MEDEVAC 9-line. Then call Helped a civilian.

injects.label: New key site: Pump Station
injects.text: The island’s water pump station at grid 18T TL 59657 22050 (40.81430, -77.84961), play square C2 is now a key site. Whoever holds it controls the town’s water supply. It can be captured with a code word earned at the site, like the other sites.
injects.note: Before sending: Map tab, waypoint queue, Interest Point / Potential Mid Game New Site #4, Make site. Name it Pump Station, timer 15, and enter the Pump Station capture and defense words from the Station Keys. The station POCs must already be in place with the Pump Station cards and a tarp.

injects.label: They came back to the footbridge
injects.text: The farmer who watches the D6 footbridge says two men came back at first light and pushed a paint can under the near end at grid 18T TL 59719 21792 (40.81199, -77.84877), play square D6, then ran a wire into the reeds. Treat it as a live device. Keep every cadet at least 25 m away, cordon it, keep civilians out, and send an IED 9-line through your POC. Your POC confirms the 9-line before it is reported. Report within 15 minutes.
injects.note: IED-C (reused after X6) at IP2 from 0725. Ties to the footbridge tip (intel package 6): the device that was taken away came back. Correct 9-line: Real IED cleared (+2, diplomatic +5). Walked onto it: Hit by an IED.

injects.label: They came back to the footbridge
injects.text: A farmer near the E2 footbridge says two men came back at first light and pushed a box under the near end at grid 18T TL 59840 22017 (40.81405, -77.84743), play square E2, then ran a wire into the reeds. Treat it as a live device. Keep every cadet at least 25 m away, cordon it, keep civilians out, and send an IED 9-line through your POC. Your POC confirms the 9-line before it is reported. Report within 15 minutes.
injects.note: IED-D (reused after X4) at IP7 from 0727. Ties to the footbridge tip (intel package 6). Correct 9-line: Real IED cleared (+2, diplomatic +5). Walked onto it: Hit by an IED.

injects.label: Aid supply box off target (3)
injects.text: The last Humanitarian Aid Supply Box of the morning landed off target. The aircrew only has a grid: 18T TL 59681 21999. It is not marked on any map. The first force to find it by land navigation and deliver it intact to the Marala Town office earns the town’s thanks. Do not open it.
injects.note: Humanitarian Aid Supply Box #3 at IP3 from 0732. Land navigation test: the grid is not marked on the board. First force to deliver it intact: adjustment, diplomatic +5. Counts only if it reaches the town before ENDEX.

injects.label: ENDEX warning and final SITREP
injects.text: ENDEX in 10 minutes. Finish current tasks and start no new contention. Your final SITREP to the AOC is due at {+110} on the AOC tab: sites held, PIRs answered, casualties and incidents, open issues. At ENDEX, hold in place and account for every cadet, LMR and training rifle.
injects.note: Send at 0745. No POC action.

injects.label: The mayor’s warning
injects.text: The mayor is alarmed by the incidents of the last half hour. He warns both forces: one more act of provocation and he will close his office to the force responsible.
injects.note: Send when escalation reaches Tension. No scoring; the warning is real: use the town office override if a force provokes again.

injects.label: AOC restraint
injects.text: AOC: both national commands are concerned about a wider conflict. The ROE are restrictive for the next 10 minutes. Start no new contention, show of force, jamming or strike. Keep fireteams at least 50 m from the other force and use the liaison channel before any move toward a held site.
injects.note: Send when escalation reaches Crisis. AOC: set the ROE to Restrictive, 10 minutes, both forces, on the Command tab. The board then refuses those actions.

injects.label: Operational pause
injects.text: OPERATIONAL PAUSE. Both governments have agreed to a 5-minute pause. All fireteams halt in place. Commanders exchange at least one liaison message proposing a way to lower tension before movement resumes.
injects.note: Send at Brink. AOC: set the ROE to Operational pause, 5 minutes, both forces, on the Command tab. Resume after both forces send a liaison message.
